name: router
useCase: Identify a wireless router or open its network settings.
misuse: Do not use the router alone to indicate that a wireless network has internet access.

16.reason: Short antenna rods remain separate from the wireless arc. Centered circular indicators leave 1px to the top and bottom housing borders.

24.reason: Longer antenna rods leave at least 1.5px before the wireless arc; larger indicator strokes remain centered inside the housing.
